newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria railway sets up venture with Austria's VA.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria railway sets up venture with Austria's VA.

text.p: Bulgarian State Railways (BSR) on Thursday signed an agreement with Austria's VAE AG to establish a joint venture for the production of railway points.
A BSR statement said VAE will hold a 51 percent stake in the newly established venture, named Vauae Sofia, and BSR will have a 49 percent stake.
The joint venture will invest 116 million levs in technological modernisation of a railway point workshop at a Sofia plant.
The venture plans also to supply countries from the Balkan region and the Middle East with railway points, the statement said.
